newsitem.title: USA: Madison Gas files rate increase request.
newsitem.headline: Madison Gas files rate increase request.

text.p: Madison Gas & Electric Co said Tuesday it filed a request with the Public Service Commission of Wisconsin to raise rates for natural gas and electricity.
It requested a 5.1 percent or $7.7 million increase in electric rates and a 3.8 percent or $3.7 million increase in natural gas rates, to take effect July 1, 1997.
The company said it would be the first rate hike in seven years. It said electric rates were reduced twice and gas rates three times since 1990.
Rates for an average residential electric customer would increase about $2 a month under the proposal. A typical residential gas-heating customer would see an annual increase of about $29.
Madison Gas & Electric said the rate increase would cover investments in the Kewaunee Nuclear Power Plant needed to maintain the option of closing the plant before its license expires in 2013.
